hero.subtitle: Design perfect conversations by assembling AI context with blocks. A new way to communicate with AI through visual control of personas, rules, and data.

features.sectionSubtitle: Discover the core features that make BlockMind the most advanced AI context management platform.

items.title: Context Block System
items.description: Organize personas, rules, data, and output formats as independent blocks for clear AI context management. Add or remove blocks to adjust AI behavior in real time.

items.title: Visual Control
items.description: Reorder blocks by priority with drag and drop, and toggle activation with a click. Visually confirm exactly which context your AI is currently following.

items.title: AI Tool Calling
items.description: AI analyzes the conversation flow and automatically generates the blocks you need. Even without manual input, AI understands context and suggests the optimal block structure.

integration.sectionSubtitle: Build perfect AI context with four block types. Each block works independently and combines seamlessly.
integration.tip: Drag blocks to reorder them, and click to activate or deactivate.

footer.description: The next-generation platform for designing perfect conversations by assembling AI context with blocks.
